summary: Adapter is stateless and forbids shell execution; preparation requires declared slice, nonempty contract/validator hashes, and a passing Skill-input gate; TDD lifecycle is ordered RED→GREEN→REFACTOR; RED requires expected failing exit and test/docs-only paths; GREEN requires prior observed RED, zero exit, production-only paths; REFACTOR requires prior GREEN, zero exit, and declared production/test/docs paths; invalid transitions return blocked diagnostics; finalized result is a non-authoritative implementation candidate with no authorizations; resume rejects stale identities and failed/stale/superseded runs; stage bindings require capsule-attempt bundle schema rmap.capsule-attempt-bundle.v1, unique stage context/attempt, matching plan/slice/run/attempt IDs, STAGE-{stage} binding, empty authorizations; protocol persistence validates artifact keys/types, required ordered documents, run-contained paths, no symlinks/reparse points, immutable conflicts, and undeclared files; decision artifacts are written after other attempt records; execute refuses existing run directories, requires protocol bundle and artifact store together, persists recovery-state.v1 with run and identity lineage, stages, empty authorizations, and optional Skill-input hashes.
